## 3. Capacity

### Essential

- Up to 10 qualifying short-form videos per billing month
- One active production slot
- Up to three revision rounds per video

### Unlimited

- Unlimited request queue
- One active production slot
- Unlimited revision rounds within the agreed brief

### Priority

- Unlimited request queue
- Two active production slots
- Unlimited revision rounds within the agreed brief
- Priority queue for eligible starts and revisions

## 12. Intellectual property

After full payment, Paradigm assigns its copyright in bespoke final deliverables to the Customer, expressly including the rights under Articles 27 and 28 of the Japanese Copyright Act, subject to the Terms.

Excluded from assignment:

- Customer materials
- Third-party materials and licenses
- Paradigm background materials
- Pre-existing templates, methods, know-how, workflows, generic components, and production systems

Moral rights non-exercise: as stated in the Terms.
